title_sq: Okazion! Prane Tregut Elektrik, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2, Ne Ndertim Te Ri!
description_sq: Okazion! Prane Tregut Elektrik, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2, Ne Ndertim Te Ri ! Apartamenti me siperfaqe totale 101.58 m², ndodhet ne katin e 4 banim te nje ndertimi te ri me fasade te ventiluar dhe cilesi te larte ndertimi. Organizohet nga salloni i ndenjes bashke me kendin e gatimit, dhoma matrimoniale me tualet me vete, dhoma e gjumit te femijeve, tualeti dites dhe ballkoni. Orientimi i tij eshte Lindje. Objekti eshte i organizuar me dy kate parkimi nentoke, kati perdhe dedikuar totalisht ambienteve te biznesit dhe mbi te zhvillohen 9 kate banimi. Disa nga benefitet e kompleksit jane: fasade e ventiluar, dritare me dopjo xham me mbushje me gaz per minimizimin e zhurmave dhe termoizolim, izolim akustik ne ndarjet ndermjet apartamenteve, sistem i pergatitur i ngrohjes qendrore. Oborri i brendshem eshte nje hapesire e plotesuar me stola dhe gjelberim, ne pjesen e pasme te kompleksit, pjesa veri-lindore e tij.
title_en: Opportunity! Near the Electric Market, 2+1+2 Apartment for Sale, New Building!
description_en: Opportunity! Near the Electric Market, 2+1+2 Apartment for Sale, New Building! The apartment with a total area of ​​101.58 m² is located on the 4th residential floor of a new building with a ventilated facade and high quality construction. It is organized by a living room with a kitchenette, a matrimonial room with its own toilet, a children's bedroom, a day toilet and a balcony. Its orientation is East. The facility is organized with two floors of underground parking, the ground floor is completely dedicated to business premises and 9 residential floors are to be developed above. Some of the benefits of the complex are: ventilated facade, double-glazed windows with gas filling to minimize noise and thermal insulation, acoustic insulation in the partitions between apartments, prepared central heating system. The inner courtyard is a space filled with benches and greenery, at the back of the complex, its north-eastern part.
